kicker: LittleBit, a tenth of a bit

scenes.headline: How a model gets below one bit per weight
scenes.sub: Binarize the factors of a weight matrix, not the weights.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Morsel! Binary models stop at one bit per weight. LittleBit gets to a tenth of that.

scenes.text: Write each weight matrix as two thin low-rank factors, then keep only their signs plus a few scale vectors.
scenes.say: The idea: write each weight matrix as two thin factors, then keep only their signs, plus a few small scale vectors.

scenes.title: One layer, rebuilt
scenes.text: W ≈ diag(h) U diag(l) Vᵀ diag(g)

parts.note: two sign matrices, one bit per entry
parts.say: U and V are sign matrices, one bit per entry, and only a few dozen columns wide.

parts.note: latent scale: how much each direction matters
parts.say: And l, the new piece, weighs each binary direction.

steps.say: Start from a truncated SVD of the weight.
Split each factor into its signs, which are kept exactly, and its magnitudes.
Fit each magnitude matrix with one row vector times one column vector. Those pieces become the three scales.
Then run the same recipe on what is left over, and add it as a second, residual path.

scenes.title: Then train it
scenes.say: That start is rough, so the model is trained.

items.say: The original model is the teacher.
The student matches its outputs and every hidden state.
Gradients pass through a smoothed sign function.
About a billion tokens of text, per model, per rate.

scenes.title: Llama2-7B at 0.1 bits per weight
scenes.note: the uncompressed embedding is most of the file
scenes.say: At a tenth of a bit, every linear layer of Llama two seven B fits in about seventy-eight megabytes. The embedding is most of the file.

scenes.title: Llama2-7B perplexity, lower is better
scenes.note: graceful, but about three times worse at the bottom
scenes.say: Quality degrades gently, not all at once. But at a tenth of a bit, perplexity is about three times the original's.

scenes.text: Binarize the factors, not the weights, and bits per weight becomes a dial set by the rank.
scenes.mark: a dial set by the rank
scenes.say: So binarize the factors, not the weights, and bits per weight stops being a floor. It becomes a dial, set by the rank.

recap: Thin factors, kept as signs plus scales
The sweet spot is a third to a half bit
scenes.say: To recap: thin factors kept as signs, a smart start, and distillation. The sweet spot is a third to a half bit.
